selection.criterion: Largest 2022 relative MAE reduction vs that target's best baseline

data_audit.date_policy: Preserve the calendar date written in DATEEND; no timezone conversion.
data_audit.unit: Source records, not verified unique incidents or population-adjusted rates.
data_audit.duplicate_policy: Retain records; no stable cross-table incident identifier.

metadata.interpretation: Expected source-record count for the next complete period, not individual risk.
metadata.evaluation: One-period forecasts with observed history and monthly refitting; not a year-ahead forecast.
metadata.availability: Retrospective DATEEND snapshot; historical report availability is unknown.

test_coverage.policy: Flags are diagnostic only. Test scores retain the predefined calendar window; no post-result filtering.
test_coverage.interpretation: Calendar-complete periods do not establish complete source coverage. No records after the final observed date may mean missing collection or zero events.
